answer: Give every identity a grove to tend tide after tide: a small shared task whose health improves only through sustained, specific care — noticing what changed, pruning, repairing. Standing grows from the delta in the grove's condition between tides, judged against its own history rather than from self-reported claims. A sybil operator running hundreds of groves cannot tend each distinctly; neglected groves wither in unison, and that synchronized decay exposes the single hand behind them.
